findings.title: Adding data does not apply the pending visible range
findings.description: Adding the first populated series only updates `seriesCountRef`; it neither triggers a render nor changes this effect’s dependencies. Consequently, an existing Context range remains unapplied until `range` changes again. The translation test masks this by calling `setRange` after adding the series. Trigger synchronization when data becomes available and test adding data without changing the range.

findings.title: Series existence is not a valid data-availability guard
findings.description: `addSeries` increments the counter even for valid configs with `data: []`, while `updateSeries` can clear all data without updating it. The range effect therefore treats an empty time scale as populated, defeating its explicit protection against invalid range calls. Track actual data availability across additions, updates, and removals; cover empty-series and cleared-data cases.
